issues.description: Book struct property name mismatch: The problem statement requires a Book with a String property named `title` (and `author`) (problem_statement.md lines 16-18). In the solution implementation (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 24-33) the Book struct declares the title field as `bookTitle: String`. Meanwhile the Client code in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift uses the identifier `title` in two places: it constructs books using `Book(title: ...)` (Client.swift lines 34-36) and prints `book.title` (Client.swift line 11). This naming divergence (expected `title` vs implemented `bookTitle`) will cause compilation errors and will confuse students about the expected property name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Book's title identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the Book struct property `bookTitle` to `title` in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift (and update any doc comments) so the memberwise initializer and Client code (Book(title:...), book.title) compile and match the problem statement. Alternatively, update all call sites and the problem text to use `bookTitle`, but keeping `title` is recommended to match the exercise description.
